title: primula russeola subsp. lancifolia
intro:
Primula russeola subsp. lancifolia, commonly known as a plant species in the Primulaceae family, is a type of flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Primula russeola subsp. lancifolia are attributed to its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which may help in alleviating coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.

Note: The information about the health benefits, therapeutic actions, and bioactive constituents of Primula russeola subsp. lancifolia is based on general knowledge about the Primula genus, as specific information about this plant species is limited.
